description.zh: 计费类型；后付费：payasyougo/预付费：subscription
description.en: The billing method. Valid values: payasyougo (pay-as-you-go) and subscription.

description.zh: 商品code；eg. 中国站： 后付费的商品code为odps， 预付费的商品code为odpsplus ； 国际站 ：后付费的商品code为odps_intl， 预付费的商品code为odpsplus_intl；
description.en: The commodity code. Example: On Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com), the commodity code for pay-as-you-go is odps and the commodity code for subscription is odpsplus. On Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com), the commodity code for pay-as-you-go is odps_intl and the commodity code for subscription is odpsplus_intl.

description.zh:
配额商品规格

><notice>

- 仅在预付费(subscription)情况下需要填写
cu 最小单位为50
ord_time 支持包月(month)和包年(year)

- 创建之后 commodityData 不支持修改,如需修改请在MaxCompute控制台操作

></notice>
description.en:
The commodity specifications of the quota.

><notice>

- This parameter is required only for subscription quotas.
The minimum unit for cu is 50.
ord_time supports monthly (month) and yearly (year) billing.

- After creation, commodityData cannot be modified. To modify it, go to the MaxCompute console.

></notice>

description.zh: ><notice>仅在预付费(subscription)情况下需要填写></notice>
description.en: ><notice>This parameter is required only for subscription quotas.></notice>

descriptions.zh: **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解MaxCompute产品的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/product/maxcompute/pricing?spm=5176.30275541.J_ZGek9Blx07Hclc3Ddt9dg.2.19502f3dPPfezu&scm=20140722.S_card@@%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81@@143540.S_new~UND~card.ID_card@@%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81@@143540-RL_MaxCompute-LOC_2024SPSearchCard-OR_ser-PAR1_213c994b17738148516424527d0d07-V_4-RE_new9-P0_0-P1_0)。**
descriptions.en: **Before using this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing method and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/product/maxcompute/pricing?spm=5176.30275541.J_ZGek9Blx07Hclc3Ddt9dg.2.19502f3dPPfezu&scm=20140722.S_card@@%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81@@143540.S_new~UND~card.ID_card@@%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81@@143540-RL_MaxCompute-LOC_2024SPSearchCard-OR_ser-PAR1_213c994b17738148516424527d0d07-V_4-RE_new9-P0_0-P1_0) of MaxCompute.**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun maxcompute create-quota --charge-type payasyougo --commodity-data CU_:50,_ord_time_:_1:Month_,_autoRenew_:false --part-nick-name MyQuota --commodity-code odps --region cn-hangzhou
